name: waycontext-vscode
description: Engineering intelligence in the editor: search code, docs and memory, see a module's risk and owners, and assemble task context — all from a local WayContext server.

waycontext.serverUrl.description: The local WayContext server (start it with `waycontext serve`). No credentials are sent; the server has no authentication and binds to localhost.

waycontext.project.description: Indexed project name. Left blank, the project whose indexed root contains the active file is used.
